My skin is very sensitive and would react when there was too much chlorine in a pool. swimming sometimes multiple times a day I needed something to help my skin stand the chlorine and thus was great for my sensitive and acne prone skin. It’s also easy to apply with the spray applicator which is a huge time saver for me. Simply showering before and after a swim wasn’t enough for my skin or hair.

reviews.t: For Reaction to Chlorine After Swimming
reviews.x: I swim several time per week. I was having a reaction to the chlorine. Showering with soap and shampoo didn't help. I saw great results the first time I used this. I tried mixing my own (it's essentially vitamin C), but this is more convenient to take to the pool, and I think it works better.

My granddaughter had a bad rash all over her body mostly wear the swimsuit covered. I read up on this purchased it and before she would put her swimsuit on weed spray her down and by the time she came out from swimming and took a shower no problems.

It reduces the itching from swimming in a chlorinated pool.  I prefer the pressurized spray can, but this one was available on Amazon Prime when I needed it and was willing to pay more per ounce than is charged for the can.

Seems to do its job, but I would get the can with continuous spray next time. The pump got "annoying" after a bit. Other than the pump design, the contents inside work for me & I am in the pool 5-6 times a week.

claims.text: Most reviewers report the spray effectively relieves chlorine-related skin irritation, itching, and rashes.
Several reviewers say it eliminates or reduces chlorine smell after swimming, sometimes replacing a second anti-chlorine shower.
A few reviewers found the product ineffective, including one whose swimmer saw no benefit for hair.
Some reviewers note the bottle is small and the squeeze pump awkward, making it hard to cover an adult body and requiring generous use.
Some reviewers mention the price is high or that they considered making their own vitamin C mixture, though they find the product more convenient.
